description: Train the pinned R binary or direct-multiclass perceptron with deterministic row order.

input.encoding: [learning_rate, n_epochs, sample_count, feature_count, row-major training features, labels, query_count, row-major query features]

contract.initialization: Initialize binary or class-major weight parameters to zero; prepend an intercept feature equal to one. Sort numeric classes ascending. Do not shuffle and do not seed an RNG.
contract.binary_update: Map the lower class to -1 and the higher class to +1. For each input-order row, update the one weight vector by learning_rate*encoded_label*augmented_row when encoded_label*score <= 0.
contract.multiclass_update: Choose the first maximum score. On a mistake, add learning_rate*augmented_row to the true class weights and subtract it from the predicted class weights.
contract.stopping: Run exactly n_epochs for both modes; the source does not stop early.
contract.prediction: Binary scores at least zero return the higher class; multiclass prediction returns the class with the first maximum score.
contract.output: Return class_count, sorted class values, parameter_count, the binary intercept-first vector or multiclass class-major matrix, query_count, and original class predictions.
contract.errors: Reject malformed framing, fractional/out-of-range values, labels with fewer than two or more than three distinct values, and invalid features with -1. Null output or insufficient capacity returns -2 without writes.
